key_insight: Adaptive discretization and local spin-glass mappings enable continuous-variable optimization within finite qubit representations.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a flexible route for mapping continuous engineering objectives into qubit-based quantum and quantum-inspired optimization pipelines.
method: Adapt the discretization instead of relying on a fixed search grid.
Iteratively map the objective locally onto an effective spin-glass Hamiltonian.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports competitive solutions on unconstrained and constrained n-dimensional Gramacy-Lee benchmarks and a proof-of-concept IMRT inverse-planning problem.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative runtime, qubit-resource, or quantum-advantage evidence, leaving practical scalability uncertain.
paper_title: Adaptive Qubit Encoding for Continuous-Variable Quantum Optimization
